name: Gemma 4 E4B
short: Google DeepMind's ~4.4B open-weight edge model (Apache 2.0, 128K) for Pi/Jetson/mobile agents; MMLU 69.4%, LiveCodeBench 52.0%, native image+audio input.
contextWindow: 128,000 total (half the 256K of the larger Gemma 4 variants)
modalities: Text, image, audio in; video as frames; text out
standout: The edge-native agent: native image and audio input on a ~4B open model that fits Pi, Jetson and phones.
tradeoff: Edge-class depth — it perceives and answers simply, nothing more.
